one_star_reviews.text:
My overall rating is 1, and it doesn't deserve any better. I'll detail my booking.
Customer service and staff on arrival = Rating 1
Customer service and staff on departure = Rating 1
No vehicle inspection with the customer = Rating 0
The customer has to do the inspection themselves instead of the staff = Rating 0
When you hear "Don't worry..." it's already suspicious.
Rented car = Kia Stonic Hybrid, 4 out of 5. Luckily, the car was good because we drove over 300 km during our stay.
The tank wasn't full at the start = 570 km range when I started the car, whereas on return, I filled it up and it had a range of 640 km minus the 20 km from the hotel to the airport = Rating 0
Rental price was good = €365 for 10 days on the Douyouspain platform, but there are other companies with similar rates.

For all your vehicle reservations, I strongly advise users to choose the "Full-to-Full" fuel system and check the "security deposit guarantee" box, and to book in advance rather than directly at the airport, even if it's not at all convenient for you when picking up your vehicle.

It's unacceptable to allow customers to take videos and photos of the vehicle to later prove there were no bodywork issues upon return. It reeks of a scam if you have a problem.

It's also unacceptable that people who haven't booked in advance are given priority over those who already have a reservation.
We arrived at the airport at 10:00 PM and didn't pick up our vehicle until 11:00 PM. A complete scandal.
Returning the car is the same story, with at least a 30-40 minute wait, so it's advisable to carefully coordinate your vehicle return time with your flight schedule.

Overall, I do not recommend this company at all and I would not rent from them again during our next stay in Ibiza.

Beware of this company! They have cheap prices online, but then when you go to pick up the car, you get a hefty price tag. If the driver doesn't have a credit card (even if the passengers do), they force you to buy insurance through them, which, surprise surprise, is much more expensive than the rental itself. In the end, the whole thing costs you more than double what you booked. Avoid them if you can!

One star because you can't give zero. Terrible service, even worse manners, empathy... what empathy???

We arrived at Ibiza airport on Monday the 28th in the afternoon. We were in the queue and the first impression wasn't very good. There was an elderly Italian couple in front of us, and he was speaking to them quite rudely. When it was our turn, it was the same story. He was looking at his computer, not even looking at us. We told him we disagreed, and without looking at us, he told us to file a complaint, saying he wasn't the owner. A shameless jerk. We just returned the car, and the guy who was there next was very friendly. We will never rent from them again.

A very disappointing experience and an excessively rigid customer service policy.

We made a mistake when booking and added an extra day we didn't need. We realized it almost immediately, but the company has refused to change the date or refund the cost of that extra day.

What's most incomprehensible is their own policy: they state that a booking can only be modified within the first two hours of creation, but only if those two hours coincide with the Sales Department's hours, which are Monday to Friday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Therefore, if you make a booking on a Saturday and realize the mistake a minute later, you can't do anything at all because their department is closed. By the time they come back to assist you, you're already outside the two-hour window. In practice, the customer loses their money even if they noticed the error immediately.

So, if anyone is going to book with this company, I would almost recommend doing so only during the week and within their business hours, because if any problem arises outside of those hours, it seems the customer has to shoulder everything.

I understand that there are non-refundable rates and conditions, but anyone can make a mistake. It's one thing to apply certain conditions and another to show absolutely no flexibility, common sense, or willingness to find a solution to an issue reported immediately.

We also requested a second review of the case, and the response was the same: no solution, no alternative, and no concessions whatsoever.

After this experience, I believe their customer service leaves much to be desired, and I will personally think twice before booking with this company again.

The car was delivered dirty. They gave me a 2008, and as soon as I got in I noticed the tire warning light. I went out to check the flat tires, and when I got back, I exchanged the 2008 for a Kia Stonic that was even dirtier than the Peugeot. When I returned the car, they didn't even come to look at it because they said I had full insurance and that I'd get my deposit back in 24 hours.
Moral of the story: after 72 hours, I still haven't received my deposit back.
If I call from Italy, they don't answer, and the only time I spoke to them, they pretended not to understand.
NEVER AGAIN

I STRONGLY ADVISE AVOIDING THIS CAR RENTAL COMPANY — IN MY EXPERIENCE, IT WAS UNSAFE AND VERY DISAPPOINTING.

I had originally booked a BMW automatic convertible, but when I arrived at the rental desk I was simply told that it was not available, despite the reservation. I ended up with a Fiat 500C instead.

On 23 July 2026, I parked the car in the Cala d’Hort / Cala Vedella area. The car was locked, the boot was closed, and our luggage was hidden inside. We were away for only around 13 minutes.

When we returned, there were no broken windows, no visible damage and no obvious signs of forced entry. Only after driving away did we realise that our suitcases and backpacks had disappeared from the boot.

The stolen belongings included clothing, documents, electronics and other personal items worth around €6,000.

I am not claiming that OK Mobility was responsible for the theft itself, but I find it extremely concerning that a locked rental car could apparently be accessed without visible damage.

What made the experience even worse was the response afterwards. I contacted OK Mobility to report the theft, but in my view they simply washed their hands of the situation and provided no meaningful help.

Between receiving a different car than the one booked, the theft from a locked vehicle and the lack of useful support afterwards, this was a very poor experience.

I WOULD NOT RENT FROM OK MOBILITY AGAIN. If you do, never leave anything in the car, even in a locked boot.

If you don't want to waste your time on vacation in Ibiza, don't book with them.

If you don't want to waste your time on holiday in Ibiza, don't hire them.

one_star_reviews.text:
I'm giving it one star because I can't give it zero.

Three months have passed since we left the apartment, and we waited until now to write this review because, honestly, we needed some distance from the whole situation and to find the right words to calmly recount our experience. We didn't want to write it in the heat of the moment, but we believe that after this time it's important to share what we went through.

The worst rental experience we've ever had. We wish someone had warned us before we moved in.

We were two students, and studying in this apartment was practically impossible. I had afternoon classes and needed the mornings to study and rest, but the landlord showed up constantly, often every morning, unannounced and with absolutely no regard for our peace and quiet. We were constantly wondering when he was going to show up again. It was a tense atmosphere.

As if that weren't enough, as soon as we moved in, they started work on the boiler that lasted almost three months. Every morning there were workers coming and going, constant noise, and daily disturbances. It was impossible to concentrate on studying or resting. We even had to eat with the construction workers because they were constantly inside the apartment.

The lack of privacy was constant throughout our stay. The landlord would enter or try to enter the apartment without warning and controlled absolutely everything. He even tried to enter when I needed privacy and wouldn't open the door. We had never felt so uncomfortable living in an apartment.

The problems with money started from the very beginning, not at the end of the rental period. The landlord would come to the apartment demanding payment for bills that hadn't even arrived in the mailbox yet. Since we were students and "trusted" what he told us, we ended up paying amounts that we later discovered weren't even ours. To this day, he still owes us money, and we have receipts for all those payments. Even so, he continues to refuse to pay us back.

The most outrageous thing was the day we went to return the keys in June. We went to the agency in person and begged them to help us resolve the issue with the invoices, as they were fully aware that we shouldn't have paid them and had even admitted it themselves. However, the young man who was helping us suddenly left and never returned because he didn't want to deal with the problem. We were left to endure the situation without any help or intervention from the agency.

As if that weren't enough, they also deducted part of our deposit, claiming there were more outstanding invoices. We repeatedly asked the agency to send us the supposed invoices justifying this deduction, but they refused. They didn't answer our WhatsApp messages, didn't send any documents, and simply ignored all our complaints.

If you're considering renting here, keep absolutely all receipts, demand all invoices in writing, and double-check every single euro they ask for. Our experience was a complete nightmare for two years.

How unprofessional. I had been told that on X day, from X to X time, I would be shown an apartment I was interested in (I have verifiable conversations). I had been trying to contact them since the beginning of September to arrange a viewing and discuss how we could coordinate, as I work mornings and they didn't give me any option (or even respond through the app) to visit the apartment until recently, when they finally offered me a Thursday afternoon.

However, when I called to confirm, I was told that no appointment had been scheduled and nothing had been finalized, despite our previous conversations about it.

After all this time trying to get them to schedule the visit, I consider this a sign of extremely poor professionalism and a lack of commitment, especially for a business that deals directly with the public.

For my part, after this experience, I will definitely not be looking for a property with them again, regardless of the type of transaction.
